creator: evilspoons
content:
Hi there.

I'm in Alberta, where we have recently changed timezones. Note that the CLOCK has not changed yet, as we are still before the date in November when we would "fall back". We were UTC-6 summer and UTC-7 winter. Windows called this "Mountain Time (USA and Canada), but now the "Mountain Time (Alberta)" timezone is in Windows after the 2026-09 Preview Update (KB5124010) (26300.9550).

When connecting to Shaw.ca's IMAP servers, the certificates that were valid prior to the Windows update are now reported as invalid. This has been confirmed across two separate PCs with different email accounts. The data for the certificate LOOKS valid (see screenshot) and is the same before and after the timezone change.

The failure occurred on the latest ESR release of Thunderbird, as well as 156.0 and 157.0 non-ESR.

Thanks :)

content: • 起きている問題： アドレス帳やメール表示において、名前の表示形式を「敬称（接頭称）＋名前」にしているにもかかわらず、「名前＋敬称」の順（あるいは英語順のまま）で表示されてしまう。 • 本来あるべき姿： 日本語環境では、接頭辞（Mr.やDr.など）は名前の前に正しく配置される、もしくは日本語の「様（接尾辞）」に合わせた並び順が選択できるべきである。

title: Need to recover 2 yrs of emails after fresh install of Ubuntu
creator: netsurfau
content:
Due to issues with upgrading from Ubuntu 24.04.1 to 26.04.1, I decided to just start from scratch with a new clean install.

After finalising the install, I copied across my Thunderbird data to the new partition, merging directories as the data copied across. But, somewhere in the transfer I lost about the last two years emails, with only emails up until 12/24 being available.

There are a lot a important emails I need to recover, and I'm guessing they're still on my PC, in the old partition, and I desperately need help to recover them.
